sampling.scope: Passive production-only observer, same endpoints/semantics in both arms, never feeds controller decisions. Fixed polling may miss shorter faults. Two seconds between completed samples; duration and failures remain in raw timestamps.

fields.scenario: Explicit input scenario; S0 denotes healthy.
fields.trial_id: Unique collector run identifier; native campaign IDs retained in raw evidence.
fields.application_sha: Full frozen candidate commit SHA, never the controller SHA.
fields.image_identity: Frozen immutable candidate Docker image ID; shared by both arms.
fields.pipeline_start: UTC timestamp immediately before launching the controller/entry workflow; preparation excluded.
fields.pipeline_end: UTC timestamp after the launched controller/operator terminates and the final common sample completes.
fields.deployment_start: First production Docker replacement command start during the trial; null if none.
fields.deployment_end: Last successfully completed production Docker replacement command end; includes recovery replacement; null if none.
fields.first_fault_unhealthy_time: Earliest common production unhealthy sample or observed injected/deterministic fault event; includes deployment downtime; null if never observed.
fields.first_recovered_healthy_time: First common healthy sample strictly after first fault/unhealthy; when no fault, first healthy sample. Not controller acceptance time.
fields.final_health: Last common production sample: running expected frozen image, healthz, compiled SHA/VERSION, configured external URL and authenticated sentinel read; false on errors; null if not sampled.
fields.final_deployed_release: Observed production application SHA and image identity; null values mean unavailable.
fields.candidate_delivered: Final common health true AND observed SHA/image equal requested candidate; recovery to baseline is false.
fields.retry_count: Native execution attempts above attempt 1; excludes HTTP retries, health rechecks and deployment of a separate recovery entity. Null unless complete native controller start/end evidence is retained.
fields.reobservation_count: Native controller health rounds above round 1 within each native observation sequence; excludes passive common samples and operator final verification. BDI uses controller-journal telemetry_measurement; conventional uses health_observation. Native worker/operator final checks are excluded.
fields.recovery_rollback_selected: Explicit native rollback_selected, bdi_recovery_decision or repair_started event. Selection can occur without reconsideration. Never inferred from unhealthy samples. Null if native evidence is incomplete and no positive event exists.
fields.recovery_rollback_executed: Explicit rollback entity execution began, rollback_executed or repair_started event; does not imply success. Null if native evidence is incomplete and no positive event exists.
fields.github_workflow_count: Distinct correlated actual GitHub workflow run IDs (including associated CI) collected; zero only for local executions; null if remote evidence missing.
fields.github_job_count: Started, non-skipped GitHub job executions, across all recorded run attempts; identified by job ID. A never-started/skipped job is not execution cost.
fields.human_intervention: Explicit list of timestamp/action records after pipeline_start; [] only on operator attestation; null if unknown. Initial launch/preparation excluded.
fields.github_run_ids: Correlated actual GitHub IDs; no synthetic local IDs.

missing: Use null for unavailable measurements, never impute success or a zero cost.
limits: Controller architecture, policy, sidecars/workload, runtime OS and restart policy remain treatments, not standardized by this contract.
